verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway gives some first-party visibility into MCP usage: every call through it is logged, and the directory API spec lists /v1 'usage' paths. Nothing in the pack shows an analytics view that breaks usage down by call volume, user, error or cost for servers an org consumes or publishes. missing for 10: documented usage analytics dashboard or reports, call-volume metrics, per-user breakdowns, error-rate reporting, cost attribution, coverage of published servers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing
